title: P2 principal.offboard: request
description: A person leaves for good: disabling and an erasure request by the scope (tenant, subject) with the reason offboarding; a principal_left notice to the admins (IDN-13). The operation exists since v0.1 (MEM-4, RET-7, PRM-14); by the rule LCY-3, since v0.2 offboarding moves the principal to offboarded, publishes principal.offboarded and deletes its Identity. The body is the same in both versions.

subject.description: The principal who leaves: an opaque id human:p_<ULID> (a training handle in fixtures).
